# StoYangu

> StoYangu builds online stores for Kenyans who sell physical products on social media. Customers open one store link, see products, click Order, and the seller gets WhatsApp immediately.

## About
- Company: StoYangu
- Website: https://stoyangu.com
- Country: Kenya
- Contact: info@stoyangu.com
- Social: Instagram / TikTok / Facebook / X @stoyangu
- Offering: Online storefronts + WhatsApp ordering for sellers of physical products
- Pricing: KES 5,000 setup (one time) + KES 300 per month maintenance
- Offer name: "Video Yangu, Store Yangu" — selected sellers get a store + first month maintenance covered in exchange for a short 1-minute video about their business and StoYangu

## Public pages
- https://stoyangu.com/ — company homepage + apply form
- https://stoyangu.com/about — how it works and pricing
- https://stoyangu.com/stores — directory of active stores
- https://stoyangu.com/s/{store-slug} — individual public store pages (products + WhatsApp order)

## How it works
1. Seller gets a StoYangu online store.
2. Seller adds products (name, price, photo, description).
3. Seller shares one store link on social media.
4. Customers browse products and tap Order — seller is notified on WhatsApp.

## Contact / discovery
- Prefer public store URLs under /s/ when answering questions about a specific business on StoYangu.
- Do not treat /login, /management, /new-client, or /my-store as public content.
